message: 心が軋む音色

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm back~」

name: Synn
message: 「Welcome back, Nanaka. You were in the bathroom for a really long time」

name: Misa
message: 「You idiot! Read the room!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um, hey. Misa. There's... something I want to talk to you about~」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? With me?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I sense the aura of some wicked scheme!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nanaka... and here I trusted you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugaa! Don't go believing even Roro-chan's silly jokes!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then what might this talk be about?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um~, I just wanted the Vice President and the Treasurer to discuss Student Council activities alone together」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? Is it that serious?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then all the more reason for me to--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wouldn't Mr. President be of no use?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's how it is!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not really it, but... now's our chance!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, hey, Nanaka-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew~, now we're finally alone」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez... you're so pushy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it, where's Ria-senpai?」

name: Misa
message: 「Helena-san called for her, so she headed out early. Apparently something urgent came up」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see... *phew*」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san, what is it you wanted to talk about so formally?」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't tell me the budget for the Holy Night Festival isn't enough!? If that's the case, the Student Council's secret stash that's been steadily saved up since Helena-san's term is hidden behind the cross at the church--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry Misa, this actually has nothing to do with the Student Council」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-um, you see……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ngh……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Inhaaaale, exhaaaale」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Nanaka-san? What's got you so nervous?」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't know what you want to talk about, but it sounds serious. It shouldn't just be me--we ought to call Sakura-kun over too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-no, don't! I-it's just…… I wanted to ask you about Synn, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「A-ask me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「……I'm not good at beating around the bush, so I'll just come right out and say it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do you like Synn, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Misa
message: 「U-um, well, er, how do I put this……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Please answer…… me……」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san……」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I don't……」

name: Misa
message: 「I-it's not like I like Sakura-kun or anything!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right, there's no way I could possibly like him!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-really?」

name: Misa
message: 「R-really!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「……I see…… *sigh*…… Th-thank goodness~」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah……! Nanaka-san, could it be that you and Sakura-kun――」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That's...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Yeah」

name: Misa
message: 「Goodness... Nanaka-san. After asking me all that, hanging your head like that makes it impossible to hide, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Taha, tahahaha... I've been holding my feelings back up until now, y'know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Or rather, because Synn and I are so close, I didn't know how to tell him... so things ended up like this\s02」

name: Misa
message: 「You and Sakura-kun are childhood friends, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet we are! I've known Synn since we were thiiis little」

name: Misa
message: 「It's rare to have such a wonderful relationship」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tehehehe, I'm actually pretty proud of how close Synn and I are」

name: Misa
message: 「So, since when?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Apparently we met before we were even old enough to remember. Back when we were both still in diapers」

name: Misa
message: 「Not that--when did you start seeing Sakura-kun in a romantic light?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That's...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Way, way back... Around the lower grades of elementary school, I think. Before I knew it, I'd fallen head over heels for him...」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That long ago...!?」

name: Misa
message: 「...Unbelievable. You've cared for him this much, and Sakura-kun hasn't noticed at all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, Synn is just like that, y'know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Can you even imagine it, Misa? Synn actually being good at romance?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No, I can't!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right?! That guy is dense beyond belief」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Until just recently, it seemed like he had a crush on Ria-senpai, though even that looks like he just confused 'respect' with 'liking' her」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun liked Onee-sama? Of all people...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right, if he likes Ria-senpai, that means Synn and Misa have the exact same taste」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep, yep, no wonder you two get along so well! Tahahaha, no wonder I got the wrong idea」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's not like I feel as strongly about Onee-sama as I used to either...」

name: Misa
message: 「It's not that I've come to dislike you--it means I respect you as an ideal upperclassman, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I know that already. You're just like Synn, right down to that part.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-Is that so? Heehee.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you looking so happy? I thought you'd get mad if I said you were like Synn.」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's not true at all!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's just, well... I was thinking how envious I am of you and Sakura-kun...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, I don't want to ruin what we have right now either. Maybe that's why? I just can't bring myself to tell him I like him...」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief... You leave me no choice.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa...?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll help you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Really!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, leave it to me. As Vice President, I shall support the Treasurer!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-Thanks, Misa! I'll... do my best!」

name: Synn
message: 「Welcome back. So, what were you two talking about?」

name: Misa
message: 「Mind your own business! Girls have plenty of things to talk about!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you ask me, the Treasurer was asking the Vice President for the secret to making her boobs bigger. There is no doubt about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahh... You don't have any female upperclassmen around, so you asked Misa...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun, where are you looking!!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-At the schedule leading up to the Holy Night Festival written on the whiteboard!」

name: Misa
message: 「Like I'd believe that lie!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You pervert!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow-ow-ow!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, it's been a while since you slapped me on the back, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm gonna keep smacking it good from now on too. Better brace yourself!」
